steps.why: the cold re-derivation of the framework's 'colour = three seatings' criterion (mined from the danger-zone belt/quark clue as a LEAD, derived here from scratch -- no census imported). Built cold on the 120 vertices of 2I (container 06's carrier), exact in Z[phi]: pick an order-3 element g3=(-1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2) (one of the 16 Hurwitz-type units; verified order 3). Conjugation c(x)=g3.x.g3^-1 is an inner automorphism, and since g3^3=1 it has order dividing 3; it is exactly 3 (perm^3=identity, checked). So its cycles have length 1 or 3: the length-1 cycles are the FIXED points (elements commuting with g3, the centralizer) and the length-3 cycles are COLOUR TRIPLES -- each an object in three colour seatings, cyclically permuted, the exact Z/3 the framework calls colour. Exhaustive on the 120: 6 fixed + 38 three-cycles (6 + 3*38 = 120). The 'three colours' is not chosen -- it is the ORDER of g3 (=3), so any order-3 element gives a three-fold seating. CERTIFICATION SPLIT: the kernel proves g3 has order 3 via the INTEGER quaternion (-1,1,1,1) (=2*g3, no phi) whose cube is exactly (8,0,0,0) = 8*identity, so the unit g3 cubes to 1 -- zero-axiom, integer; the full 120-element cycle structure (6+38) is EXACT-INTEGER in Z[phi] (verify-guarded, this derivation recomputes it), as container 06/13's larger computations are.

The seating count is 3 because g3 has order 3 -- and 'three' is the substrate's OWN number, not an import: (a) 2I's order-3 elements are exactly the 3-fold face rotations of the icosahedron (through the 20 triangular faces); (b) container 30's triality is det(A2 Cartan)=3=|Z(SU(3))|, the same three; (c) the floor is TRIADIC -- a distinction takes three observers (container 00, two within one without). So colour's three-ness reduces to the substrate's native 3-fold, not to a chosen structure. The FIXED points -- the 6 elements commuting with g3 -- are the centralizer C(g3): it is <g3, -1> (the order-3 g3 together with the center -1), of order 6 = Z/6, and its conjugacy class has size |2I|/|C| = 120/6 = 20 (one of 2I's two size-20 classes). These 6 are the 'colourless' seats -- invariant under the colour-cycling g3 -- the singlet-flavoured part (confinement resonance, made precise only in the correspondence CS.3). EXACT-INTEGER (verify-guarded); the count 6*20=120 is the orbit-counting check.

steps.what: THE FILED ENTRY: the three g3-seatings <-> QCD's 3 colours (SU(3) center Z/3 + fundamental)
steps.why: the entry, the four parts, and the honest refinement of the strong-force location. SUBSTRATE SIDE (checked): an order-3 element of 2I forces a Z/3 colour seating (CS.1); the three is the native 3-fold, the centralizer the colourless part (CS.2). PHYSICS SIDE (cited): QCD has 3 colours, the SU(3) center is Z/3 (triality), colour-singlet states are confined. THE CORRESPONDENCE: the three g3-seatings <-> the 3 colours (SU(3) fundamental) and the Z/3 center; the colourless centralizer <-> colour-singlets. This REFINES container 30: 30 located su(3) as A2 subset E8 -- but that embedding is a CHOICE (E8 has many A2's), flagged less-native. HERE the colour-3 and its Z/3 are NATIVE -- forced by an order-3 element of the carrier itself, tied to the substrate's own 3-fold (the triadic floor). So the strong force's FUNDAMENTAL (3 colours) and CENTER (Z/3) are now located natively; the ADJOINT (8 gluons) remains the less-native E8 side (30) and owed. WHAT DOES NOT TRAVEL: the full su(3) adjoint (three DISCRETE seatings give the center/fundamental, NOT the continuous 8-generator SU(3)); the belt-trichotomy QUARK SEATING and mass-map (PrimeFramework_BeltComplete_QuarkSeating -- DANGER ZONE, a lead mined for the Z/3 CRITERION only, its census NOT imported); the coupling alpha_s. FALSIFICATION SURFACE: an order-3 element must give exactly a three-fold seating (it does, CS.1) tied to the native 3-fold (CS.2); if colour's three were not the substrate's own three, this would fail. HONEST on 1+3+8=12: this makes colour=3 NATIVE (correcting the earlier too-quick 'coincidence' -- colour IS 3-fold here), but does NOT resurrect 1+3+8=12: the seatings give the center/fundamental-3, never an 8 or a 12-sum. A CORRESPONDENCE, WEAK (consistency, not discrimination); quarantined.
